entries.title: Genesis 42:1
segments: ¶Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?

entries.title: Genesis 42:2
segments: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.

words.text: for us from thence; that we may live

entries.title: Genesis 42:3
segments: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.

entries.title: Genesis 42:4
segments: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.

entries.title: Genesis 42:5
segments: And the sons of Israel came to buy [corn] among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 42:6
segments: And Joseph [was] the governor over the land, [and] he [it was] that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph's brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him [with] their faces to the earth.

entries.title: Genesis 42:7
segments: ¶And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food. {roughly...: Heb. hard things with them}

entries.title: Genesis 42:8
segments: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.

entries.title: Genesis 42:9
segments: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye [are] spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

entries.title: Genesis 42:10
segments: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.

entries.title: Genesis 42:11
segments: We [are] all one man's sons; we [are] true [men], thy servants are no spies.

entries.title: Genesis 42:12
segments: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.

words.text: unto them, Nay, but to see

entries.title: Genesis 42:13
segments: And they said, Thy servants [are] twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest [is] this day with our father, and one [is] not.

entries.title: Genesis 42:14
segments: And Joseph said unto them, That [is it] that I spake unto you, saying, Ye [are] spies:

words.text: unto them, That [is it] that I spake

entries.title: Genesis 42:15
segments: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.

entries.title: Genesis 42:16
segments: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether [there be any] truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye [are] spies. {kept...: Heb. bound}

words.text: of you, and let him fetch
, and ye shall be kept in prison

entries.title: Genesis 42:17
segments: And he put them all together into ward three days. {put: Heb. gathered}

words.text: And he put them all together

entries.title: Genesis 42:18
segments: And Joseph said unto them the third day, This do, and live; [for] I fear God:

entries.title: Genesis 42:19
segments: If ye [be] true [men], let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:

entries.title: Genesis 42:20
segments: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.

words.text: unto me; so shall your words

entries.title: Genesis 42:21
segments: ¶And they said one to another, We [are] verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.

words.text: us, and we would not hear

entries.title: Genesis 42:22
segments: And Reuben answered them, saying, Spake I not unto you, saying, Do not sin against the child; and ye would not hear? therefore, behold, also his blood is required.

entries.title: Genesis 42:23
segments: And they knew not that Joseph understood [them]; for he spake unto them by an interpreter. {he spake...: Heb. an interpreter was between them}

words.text: [them]; for he spake unto them by an interpreter
. {he spake...: Heb. an interpreter was between them}

entries.title: Genesis 42:24
segments: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.

entries.title: Genesis 42:25
segments: Then Joseph commanded to fill their sacks with corn, and to restore every man's money into his sack, and to give them provision for the way: and thus did he unto them.

entries.title: Genesis 42:26
segments: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.

entries.title: Genesis 42:27
segments: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it [was] in his sack's mouth.

words.text: ; for, behold, it [was] in his sack's

entries.title: Genesis 42:28
segments: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, [it is] even in my sack: and their heart failed [them], and they were afraid, saying one to another, What [is] this [that] God hath done unto us? {failed...: Heb. went forth}

entries.title: Genesis 42:29
segments: ¶And they came unto Jacob their father unto the land of Canaan, and told him all that befell unto them; saying,

entries.title: Genesis 42:30
segments: The man, [who is] the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country. {roughly...: Heb. with us hard things}

entries.title: Genesis 42:31
segments: And we said unto him, We [are] true [men]; we are no spies:

entries.title: Genesis 42:32
segments: We [be] twelve brethren, sons of our father; one [is] not, and the youngest [is] this day with our father in the land of Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 42:33
segments: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye [are] true [men]; leave one of your brethren [here] with me, and take [food for] the famine of your households, and be gone:

words.text: unto us, Hereby shall I know

entries.title: Genesis 42:34
segments: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye [are] no spies, but [that] ye [are] true [men: so] will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.

words.text: unto me: then shall I know

entries.title: Genesis 42:35
segments: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man's bundle of money [was] in his sack: and when [both] they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.

: and when [both] they and their father

entries.title: Genesis 42:36
segments: And Jacob their father said unto them, Me have ye bereaved [of my children]: Joseph [is] not, and Simeon [is] not, and ye will take Benjamin [away]: all these things are against me.

words.text: unto them, Me have ye bereaved
[away]: all these things are against me.

entries.title: Genesis 42:37
segments: And Reuben spake unto his father, saying, Slay my two sons, if I bring him not to thee: deliver him into my hand, and I will bring him to thee again.

words.text: , and I will bring him to thee again

entries.title: Genesis 42:38
segments: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
